title: Finding
description: One reliability finding: an evidence packet, not an opinion. Written by audit skills as CANDIDATE; only the verifier sets VERIFIED or DISPROVED.

ruleId.description: A code hint's rule code, e.g. handoff-after-ack, a concept id of audit/concepts.json for a design-level finding, or a rule from an audit skill's rule file, e.g. DUR-001.

operationId.description: The entry point the finding belongs to, when it is not given by the flow.

placeId.description: The place in the code the finding is about.

verifiedBy.description: Set by the verifier: model, run, outcome, note.

scenarioIds.description: A deep audit's finding: the scenarios it was derived from, the leading one first.

stepIds.description: The flow steps the finding's stories pass through; the page links to them.

concept.description: From the leading scenario: pattern (a concept id or null) and scope (STEP or CONCEPT).

tier.description: Set on findings a deep audit derived.

confidence.description: How sure it is real. Any NOT_CHECKED mitigation or unverifiable evidence caps it at MEDIUM.

status.description: A deep audit's finding is VERIFIED when one of its scenarios was verified, DISPROVED when all were disproved.

failureScenario.description: One concrete interleaving, naming the two points between which the failure happens. For a deep audit's finding it is generated from the leading scenario's story.

mitigationsChecked.description: Every mitigation the rule lists, with what was found.

verification.description: Failure-injection or test steps that would prove or disprove the finding.

dedupeKey.description: ruleId|flowId|primary symbol, or for a deep audit's finding ruleId|flowId|brokenAt step; equal keys are one finding.
